key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that toggles the ClipItTo popup
key.description: Handled by the shell itself, which is the most reliable way to open the popup on Wayland. Empty by default so it does not clash with a GNOME custom shortcut running "clipitto --toggle"; use one or the other, e.g. ['<Control><Alt>v'].

key.name: capture-primary
key.summary: Also record the primary selection (text that is merely selected)
